Class Scenario

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.scenario.Scenario
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Scenario extends Object implements Serializable
Complete Scenario configuration model for SwarmForge simulations. Encapsulates master random seed, terrain, climate, demographic setups, behavior engine assignments per caste, event schedules, and academic evaluation metrics.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
